name: @djgrant/chatgpt/clear
description: Deletes the logged-out chatgpt.com conversation by reloading the tab (a logged-out chat only exists in the page). Requires allow-writes. Unrecoverable — read it with @djgrant/chatgpt/chat first if you need it.

resolve.prompt: This is chatgpt.com after a reload. Return {cleared} where cleared is true when no conversation turns ('You said:' / 'ChatGPT said:') are visible and the empty chat composer is shown, and false otherwise.
